repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The candidate reverses the subtraction order in the condition. The IR requires ($v1 - $v2) >= 20, which triggers when volume drops (v1 is high, v2 is low). The candidate uses (v2 - v1 >= 20), which triggers when volume rises (v2 is high, v1 is low). Evidence F2 confirms the IR emitted no action while the JoI emitted 'Volume dropped' because the volume held at 20 (v1=20, v2=20, diff=0) did not satisfy the reversed condition logic against the initial state of 0.
diagnosis.change_summary: Reversed the subtraction order from (v2 - v1) to (v1 - v2) to match the IR specification that triggers on a volume drop.
